request.prompt:
For each supplied observed change, propose at most one local, falsifiable relation to the final goal. Bind the changed entity to the intended target. Include irrelevant or insufficient possibilities. Give neutral visual questions and explicit falsifiers. No unobserved changes or full task tree. Return L2 JSON.

CAPABILITIES: One tabletop arm can approach, grasp, carry, release and interact with visible movable structures. It cannot pass through rigid solids, teleport or resize objects. Hidden locks, load capacity and exact reach remain unknown.

An orange panel with a gray block covers the top aperture.", "entity_id": "scene", "region_id": "f0000", "visible_relation": "initial visible scene"}, {"description": "orange panel on box", "entity_id": "o0", "region_id": "f0000", "visible_relation": "visible in supplied scene"}], "uncertainty": []}
OUTPUT CONTRACT: Exact top keys: claims, tests. Use at most 3 short claims and 3 short tests TOTAL, one test per claim; keep each string concise so the complete JSON fits. Claim item keys: claim_id, change_ids, goal_binding, relation_hypothesis, possible_effect, test_ids, falsifier. Effect=beneficial|harmful|irrelevant|unknown. falsifier must be a short string. Test item keys: test_id, neutral_question, entity_ids, requested_refs. requested_refs contains only supplied image evidence IDs such as f0000 or c0a; if no image evidence IDs were supplied, use []. Never put entity IDs in requested_refs. For target-first conditions at this stage, change_ids is empty. Cite supplied IDs only.
